title: koeleria villosa subsp. longiglumis
intro: Koeleria villosa subsp. longiglumis, commonly known as Tall Hair-grass, is a perennial grass species native to China. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which may help protect against chronic diseases such as heart disease and cancer. The therapeutic actions of Koeleria villosa subsp. longiglumis include its ability to lower blood pressure and improve cardiovascular health, as well as its potential to inhibit the growth of certain bacteria and viruses. The bioactive constituents of Koeleria villosa subsp. longiglumis include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
